assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: replacement empty playable 2D arena floor for the original paper comedy game Take Stack. Image 1 is the old floor EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is character STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Preserve the exact wide 2:1 rectangular game-field footprint of the floor. Replace the whole generic green crate-yard with an abandoned paper-recycling bureau work floor, in matching flat hand-ink art. The middle 88% MUST be completely open quiet matte warm ash-gray/desaturated sage paper concrete, slightly warmer and lighter than old floor, with only a few extremely faint short paper fibers and faded wear. Absolutely NO obstacles, crates, fences, machines, signs, props, letters, numbers, characters, colored markings, strong shadows or decoration in this central 88% area. All structural detail constrained to outermost 5% edge: a thin crooked charcoal boundary lip, shallow paper-feed channels, a few brass rivets, one small floor-drain grating at bottom-left, stapled scrap seams along the edge. Keep edges low and sparse and break them into a few calm segments. No continuous piles, no crate wall, no wire fence, no grunge haze, no grid, no perspective depth, no photorealistic concrete, no glow, no vignette. Top-down flat game floor with a gently uneven ink-cut-paper perimeter. Opaque artwork fills canvas; charcoal/cream/flat muted ash-sage palette. This texture sits beneath small animated paper actors and must stay visually subordinate to them; it is not a full illustrated scene. No text and no baked UI.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for original 2D dark-comedy paper-copy roguelite Take Stack. Use supplied image ONLY as art-direction reference: thick irregular charcoal ink contours, clean flat cream/smoke-yellow fills, one simple cel shadow, ugly-cute exhausted paper world. No realistic rendering, shiny metal, blue sci-fi, neon, glow, text, logos, numbers, scene, cast shadow or grunge overlay.
Create ONE isolated wide 3:2-proportioned inventory icon of TWO OLD PAPER COPIES stacked slightly offset, held together by ONE absurdly oversized dark gray staple at the top. Each cream folded paper has a very simple dead-tired face (heavy half-lidded black eyes, tiny resigned mouth); the rear face is slightly paler and misregistered muted sage. Paper has thick black irregular contour, one warm beige cel shadow, a small folded corner and a chipped edge. The stack fills the central 80% with generous transparent margin, all silhouette in frame. The object reads as a used-up paper duplicate, not a cassette tape or a modern device. Front/three-quarter slight view, flat production icon. Genuine transparent background, no shadow beneath it, no letters or labels.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D UI character animation strip for the ORIGINAL game TAKE STACK, Carbon Copy Purgatory. The supplied board is a world/palette reference ONLY. Design a new darkly funny SCRAP MERCHANT with SOFT rounded, irregular, hand-inked storybook shapes: a small slouching wad of old cream paper, broad pear-shaped head, drooping asymmetrical eyelids, one blunt tooth, floppy receipt ears, round little belly and loose dark sage waistcoat. A curled blank receipt bends like a hat. He looks hungry, patient and faintly dishonest. Expressive, grotesque but endearing. Loosely drawn double ink contours with occasional controlled crosshatching, flat muted bone/gray-sage/tobacco/coral fills, one shadow; drawn with a scratchy pen, NOT a polished vector logo, NOT 3D, NOT a sharp folded rectangular robot. The black comedy is in his expressions and the ridiculous fact he trades discarded versions of people. Do not copy any existing game's characters or logos. Exactly FOUR equal cells in one horizontal 3:1 animation strip, genuine transparent RGBA background. Same character, identical scale, same center and foot baseline in every cell with safe empty margins. Frame0 tired neutral closed mouth, frame1 small sly grin and one palm open for payment, frame2 embarrassed shrug with raised empty palms, frame3 comically wide round bite-mouth as though eating a price tag (no actual tag/object). Complete character in each cell, no cell borders, no words or letters, no UI, no scene, no ground or cast shadow, no glow, no extra objects. Readable at 70 pixels. Keep round flowing contours rather than pointed torn corners.
assets.refinement_prompt: Edit only the spacing and scale in this four-frame transparent merchant animation strip. Preserve the EXACT existing original character, drawing style, colors, four expressions and frame order. Keep exactly FOUR equal-width cells in one horizontal 3:1 sheet and genuine RGBA transparency. Each character must fit FULLY inside its own quarter with at least 12% transparent LEFT and RIGHT margins within that cell, including outstretched hands, paper ears and sleeves. Currently poses 1 and 2 have hands touching/crossing the cell boundaries; make the entire character in ALL FOUR cells about 78% of its current size and center it consistently at x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% of the canvas. Align the feet to one shared baseline at 84% canvas height. Do not crop, cut off, merge or redraw hands between neighbors. All four silhouettes must be complete and isolated with transparent vertical gaps at the 25%,50%,75% divisions. Keep pose0 tired neutral, pose1 sly payment grin and open palm, pose2 embarrassed empty-palms shrug, pose3 big round bite-mouth. No text, borders, marks, ground or added objects. This is production-safe cell spacing cleanup, all other art stays identical.
